snippet.title: Mini Golf - Atari ST (1988)
snippet.description:
"Mini Golf" (Hole-In-One Miniature Golf) is a miniature golf game developed by  Magic Bytes and released in 1988 on Atari ST.

"Mini Golf" provides an overhead view of each hole. The game play is controlled entirely with the mouse. You place the ball on the starting pad and click the left mouse button. Once you have placed the ball, "stretch" a line from the ball to the pointer. The direction the line is pointing is the direction the ball will go. The length of the line or the distance between the pointer and the ball is relative to the power on the shot. Once you are satisfied, click the left mouse button to putt the ball.
